text.description_html:
60 Inch Exit Door Security Bar Kit for Uneven Doors

Heavy duty security bar kit for 60" double outswing doors with uneven 3.0' (36") door x 2.0' (24") door pair. This uneven door pair is often used in Firestone Tire stores.
*Measure the doors width - NOT the door frame width.

For standard even 60" door pair (30" door x 30" door) use ESI-SB-01-0060 Outswing Double Door 60"

These exit door security bars feature a unique, patented, hook-on / lift-off operation that is easy to use and emergency sensitive.

Easy to install! No special tools required! Each package includes a storage bracket, caution sign, and installation hardware.


For use on Metal or Wood doors. The 16 gauge square steel tubing fixed security DOOR BARS are thru-bolted to the doors with the provided elevator bolts. The 1-1/4" x 62-3/4" 16 gauge square steel tubing LIFT-OFF security bar secures the door to the door frame when set in place. Prevents the doors removal even if the door hinges are cut by burglars!

The heavy duty steel security bars are finished in gray powder coat epoxy baked to a semi-gloss. "L" bolts are 6-1/2" long with zinc chromate finish.

Optional 12-1/2" "L" bolts available for deep inset doors (Inset more than 5"). (4 required).

Available in other sizes for outswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-01-0030 - Outswing Single Door up to 30"
  • ESI-SB-01-0036 - Outswing Single Door 31" - 36" (Most Common)
  • ESI-SB-01-0042 - Outswing Single Door 37" - 42"
  • ESI-SB-01-0048 - Outswing Single Door 43" - 48"
  • ESI-SB-01-0060 - Outswing Double Door 60"
  • ESI-SB-01-0072 - Outswing Double Door 72"
  • ESI-SB-01-0084 - Outswing Double Door 84"
  • ESI-SB-01-0096 - Outswing Double Door 96"

    • Available in another size for inswing doors (Measure the door width - NOT the door frame width).

  • ESI-SB-03-UV48 - Metal Frame Inswing Single Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV36 - Wood Frame Inswing Single Door up to 36"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV48 - Wood Frame Inswing Single Door up to 48"
  • ESI-SB-03-UV72 - Metal Frame Inswing Double Door up to 72"
  • ESI-SB-07-UV72 - Wood Frame Inswing Double Door up to 72"

    • You can cut the bars to length. Meaning, if you need the bar to be 58", you will cut down the 60" bar. There are 3 total bars included. The LIFT-OFF BAR (Lift Up Bar 62-3/4" length) for the inside of the doorjamb that locks the doors in place, 1 DOOR BAR (33-3/4" length for 3.0' door) and 1 DOOR BAR (21-3/4" length for 2.0' door).

    The LIFT-OFF bar is up against / inside the door jamb, the DOOR BARS are thru-bolt fastened to each door. There is no way to get the door open or off from the outside once the LIFT-OFF is put in place. Removing the door's hinge pins, hinges, or even the door knob will not matter. The door cannot be removed from the outside.
